purpose: Make graph dependency order the explicit precondition for same-process interface consumption and remove dependency-body lookup from importer operations.
question: How must same-process module checking establish interface availability before an import or re-export consumes it?
decision: For import-aware Programs, TypeChecker traverses Program::moduleGraph edges depth-first, checks each dependency before its importer, produces the dependency ModuleInterface at completed-body checking, and makes checkImport/checkReExport consume only the interface identified by the resolved module ID.

scheduling_contract.order: Every dependency edge is visited before the importing module body.
scheduling_contract.producer: checkModule remains the module-body and ModuleSymbols producer and emits one interface at completion.
scheduling_contract.consumer: checkImport and checkReExport perform no dependency ModuleStmt lookup or checkModule call on the graph path.
scheduling_contract.cycles: FrontendSession rejects source import cycles; TypeChecker rejects a malformed graph cycle as an internal error.

compatibility_boundary.semantics: Import visibility, re-export behavior, type checking, generic substitution, and diagnostics are unchanged.
compatibility_boundary.outputs: AST, module-interface text, IR, bytecode, cdbc artifacts, runtime output, and Rust VM behavior are unchanged.
compatibility_boundary.entry_modes: Single-file, stdin, and ordered direct multi-file paths retain their existing behavior.
compatibility_boundary.persistence: No interface serialization, cache key, cross-build identity, or artifact field is introduced.
compatibility_boundary.lowering: Dependency-body lowering remains until the M3A/M3B independent-module decision and proof.

migration: Use graph-aware dependency-first preflight, retain completed-module interface production, remove importer-side dependency body lookup, and reverse the Program statement container in a focused test to prove graph scheduling.
quantitative_gate: The focused ir_source_location, module_interface_emitter, and golden checks pass; verification_inventory validates 1,745 cases; and full legacy, canonical, boundary, malformed, artifact, and Rust VM commands report zero unexplained differences.
old_path_deletion_condition: Delete dependency-body producer and lowering fallback only after an independently defined module result proves interface visibility, diagnostics, linked artifacts, and VM execution without whole-program dependency checking.
affected_consumers: TypeChecker import and re-export interface consumers

focused_commands: python3 tests/run_golden_tests.py ./build/compiler_design --case module_interface --case generic_imports --case generic_method_imports --case generic_struct_method_imports --case import_basic --case re_export_namespace
